correctness.rationale: The even-sign centered-coordinate model classifies all equifacial tetrahedra up to similarity/permutation, with 0<x≤y≤z. Using A=sqrt(x²+y²), B=sqrt(x²+z²), C=sqrt(y²+z²), δ=2C, V=8xyz/3 and trihedral tan(Ω/2)=2xyz/Q for Q=ABC+x²C+y²B+z²A. Rechecked y²B+z²A≥ABC from x≤y≤z, hence Q>2ABC, and exact positive identity (AB)²−2xyzC=x^4+(xC−yz)²>0; therefore Q²>8xyzC³ and arctan t<t yields Ω²<6 V/δ³. The exact factorization of Ω²/(6V/δ³) into three factors ≤1 shows ratio→1 forces x/z→0 and xC/(yz)→1, hence y/z→0, x/y→1; converse follows from asymptotic formulas. Independent ordered integer grid and sharp family samples ε→0 corroborate analytic proof, not universal completeness.
